paper_metadata.title: A new multi-objective optimization design framework for high-temperature alloy steel via machine learning

evidence.quote: In this study, a novel multi-objective optimization design framework is proposed for developing high-temperature alloy steels with superior creep rupture time and tensile strength.

machine_learning_models.name: eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost)
machine_learning_models.dataset: 845 alloy steel samples from NIMS Creep Data Sheet

evidence.quote: The eXtreme Gradient Boosting (XGBoost) model, optimized via particle swarm optimization, achieved high predictive accuracy for creep rupture time and tensile strength, with coefficients of determination (R²) of 0.98 and 0.99, respectively.
